display.purpose: Italic emphasis inside the headline only: therapeutics and markets. Weight 400, letter-spacing -0.02em, size inherited from the headline.

headline.purpose: The hero h1. From 768px, two lines at clamp(3.8rem, 5.5vw, 5.5rem), max-width 12em. Below 768px, four lines at clamp(2.65rem, 11.2vw, 3.5rem), max-width 8.2em. Weight 400, line-height 0.96, letter-spacing -0.035em.

title.purpose: The wordmark Firstocean. 1.65rem from 768px, 1.35rem below, line-height 1, letter-spacing -0.03em.

body.purpose: The two factual lines. 1.25rem from 768px, 1.125rem below, line-height 1.55, max-width 40rem, 1.75rem between them.

field.purpose: Input text and the sent confirmation. 1.05rem, line-height 1.5.

label.purpose: Sentence-case field labels and the send action. 0.95rem, weight 400, line-height 1.5, no extra tracking. The footer uses the same size at cream 80% opacity.

shadows.name: glass
shadows.purpose: The soft lift under the form panel, the only elevated surface.

motion.name: fo-drift
motion.purpose: Crescents translate on a 7s alternate: outer 3.4px, inner 1.6px. The shipped mark always adds the once cap (animation-iteration-count: 2), so the pair runs one open and one close. It runs on load and again when the form is sent. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Send Button
components.description: The only button: square cream hairline, sentence-case label, fills cream with an ink label on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-stage { background: #616b6a; padding: 24px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: transparent; color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); border: 1px solid rgba(229, 227, 224, 0.7); border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 32px; font-family: "Lay Grotesk", "Schibsted Grotesk", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: normal; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); color: var(--ink-black, #1d1c1b); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--cream, #e5e3e0); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: Sentence-case label over a cream hairline; the stroke rises from 40% to full cream on focus.
components.css: .ds-field-stage { background: #616b6a; padding: 24px; } .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.375rem; max-width: 34rem; } .ds-field-label { color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); font-family: "Lay Grotesk", "Schibsted Grotesk", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: normal; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(229, 227, 224, 0.4); border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 0; color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); font-family: "Lay Grotesk", "Schibsted Grotesk", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; caret-color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: rgba(229, 227, 224, 0.72); opacity: 1; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); outline: none; }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: The form's only floating surface: ink at 42%, a cream edge at 38%, 18px blur, and the soft shadow.
components.css: .ds-glass-stage { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #898d8c 3%, #74635a 52%, #616b6a 100%); padding: 48px 24px; } .ds-glass { max-width: 34rem; background: rgba(29, 28, 27, 0.42); border: 1px solid rgba(229, 227, 224, 0.38); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(29, 28, 27, 0.28); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); border-radius: 0; padding: 32px 24px; color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); } .ds-glass-label { font-family: "Lay Grotesk", "Schibsted Grotesk", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Hero Headline
components.description: The two-line hero from 768px, with therapeutics and markets in display italic.
components.html:
Automate the entry of
therapeutics into markets
components.css: .ds-headline-stage { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #898d8c 3%, #74635a 52%, #616b6a 100%); padding: 32px 24px; } .ds-headline { margin: 0; max-width: 12em; color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); font-family: "Lay Grotesk", "Schibsted Grotesk", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(3.8rem, 5.5vw, 5.5rem); font-weight: 400; line-height: 0.96; letter-spacing: -0.035em; } .ds-display { font-family: "Feature Display", "Bodoni Moda", Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Typeset Firstocean, cream grotesk, the top-left lockup on the gradient.
components.css: .ds-wordmark-stage { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #898d8c 3%, #74635a 52%, #616b6a 100%); padding: 32px 24px; } .ds-wordmark { margin: 0; color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); font-family: "Lay Grotesk", "Schibsted Grotesk", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.65rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.03em; }

components.name: Aperture Mark
components.description: Five-element brand symbol in cream, cropped by the right edge, crescent drift once.
components.css: .ds-mark-stage { position: relative; height: 280px; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #898d8c 3%, #74635a 52%, #616b6a 100%); } .ds-mark { position: absolute; top: 50%; right: -34%; width: 420px; color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); transform: translateY(-50%); } @keyframes ds-drift-out { to { transform: translateX(3.4px); } } @keyframes ds-drift-out-small { to { transform: translateX(1.6px); } } @keyframes ds-drift-out-left { to { transform: translateX(-3.4px); } } @keyframes ds-drift-out-left-small { to { transform: translateX(-1.6px); } } .ds-mark .ds-drift-r-outer { animation: ds-drift-out 7s cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1) alternate; animation-iteration-count: 2; } .ds-mark .ds-drift-r-inner { animation: ds-drift-out-small 7s cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1) alternate; animation-iteration-count: 2; } .ds-mark .ds-drift-l-outer { animation: ds-drift-out-left 7s cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1) alternate; animation-iteration-count: 2; } .ds-mark .ds-drift-l-inner { animation: ds-drift-out-left-small 7s cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1) alternate; animation-iteration-count: 2; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-mark g { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The hero is the page. A vertical brand gradient fills the first viewport. From 768px the headline is two lines on the left; below that breakpoint the same words stack to four lines. On the right, the five-element aperture is cream and large enough that the viewport cuts it off. The wordmark Firstocean sits at the top left in the same grotesk. The refused arrangement is a centered logo with a caption underneath.

The next band continues the gradient's last stop and carries a glass form that overlaps the hero. Beneath that, the ground is solid black: two factual lines, then the backers and the copyright. Cream is the only ink. The crescents drift once when the page loads and once more when the form is sent.

Voice is a neutral grotesk. Two words in the headline, therapeutics and markets, switch to display italic. Lay Grotesk and Feature Display are named first in the stacks. Schibsted Grotesk and Bodoni Moda Italic are the faces the page loads.
keyCharacteristics: Three-stop vertical gradient, then the same slate under the form, then solid ink.
One foreground ink, cream; ink black is the lower ground and the button's hover text.
Grotesk for sentences; display italic for two headline words only.
The aperture is cream, enormous, and cropped by the right edge; its crescents drift once.
The form is the only glass surface: translucent ink, a cream edge, blur, and a soft shadow.
Square corners and sentence-case labels; structure is a 1px cream hairline.

rules.name: The Three-Stop Rule
rules.body: The hero gradient is vertical and stops three times: haze at 3%, earth at 52%, slate at 100%. The form band is that same slate. Everything under it is solid ink. No fourth stop.

rules.name: The One-Ink Rule
rules.body: Cream is the only foreground. Borders, the footer, and the glass edge are cream at reduced opacity. The send button's hover inverts to ink on a cream fill. Errors and the confirmation stay cream; they do not introduce a status hue.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: The grotesk sets every sentence. Display italic is only the two headline words, therapeutics and markets.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Field labels and the send action are sentence case at the label size, with no added letter-spacing. Tracked uppercase is not a label style in this system.

rules.name: The Cropped-Mark Rule
rules.body: The aperture is cream, sized far past the column, and clipped by the hero's right edge. It is not centered, and the headline is not a caption under it.

rules.name: The Glass-Only Rule
rules.body: Bands are flat. The form panel is the only surface that lifts: ink at 42% opacity, 18px of backdrop blur, a 1px cream edge at 38% opacity, and the soft shadow. No other shadow.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Corner radius is 0. The only curves are the aperture's own.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: The button's border is 1px cream at 70% opacity. An idle field is a bottom stroke at 40% that becomes full cream on focus. The glass edge is cream at 38% opacity. State changes color, not thickness.

rules.name: The Once-Drift Rule
rules.body: Crescent motion is a 7s alternate drift, outer 3.4px and inner 1.6px. The shipped mark caps that at two iterations: one open and one close. It runs on load and again when the form is sent. Reduced motion removes it.

dos: Do paint the hero with the three-stop vertical gradient (haze at 3%, earth at 52%, slate at 100%) and paint the page under the form band with solid ink.

Do set sentences in the grotesk stack, Lay Grotesk named first and Schibsted Grotesk loaded behind it, and set only therapeutics and markets in display italic, Feature Display named first and Bodoni Moda Italic loaded behind it.
Do crop the cream aperture on the hero's right edge, and run its crescent drift once on load and once when the form is sent.
Do place the form on the glass panel and keep every other surface flat.
Do draw controls square and sentence case: cream hairlines, and a send button that fills cream with an ink label on hover.
Do honor reduced motion by disabling the drift and smooth scroll.
donts: Don't center the mark, or set the headline as a caption under a logo.
Don't add a fourth gradient stop, or paint the factual lines on the gradient.
Don't set the page in one family, or use display italic outside those two headline words.
Don't style labels or the send action as tracked uppercase.
Don't add a shadow to anything except the glass panel.
